lines.t: [Intro - Deep hypnotic bass guitar loop, slow driving pocket drum beat]
[Verse 1]
Built from the dust, breathe life in my lungs...
Holding the weight of the songs left unsung...
I am the clay, You’re the hand that designs...
Break through the dark, let Your holiness shine.
[Pre-Chorus]
Cleanse the stains, break the chain
Call my name through the rain!
[Chorus]
Show me how to live!
Take this broken heart and mend it!
Show me how to live!
Breath of God, come down and send it!
[Verse 2]
Wandering blind in the valley of stone...
But I hear the whisper that I'm not alone...
[Bridge]
Revive my soul! Make me whole!
[Guitar Solo - Trippy psychedelic effects, swirling phaser, rapid helicopter tremolo, high-pitched whammy pedal siren bends, spacey experimental noise]
[Chorus]
Show me how to live!...
